{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode=Basketball |year=2017–18 |team=Rhode Island Rams |image=Rhode Island Rams logo.svg |image_size=150 |conference=Atlantic 10 Conference |short_conf=A-10 |APRank= |CoachRank= |record=26–8 |conf_record=15–3 |head_coach=[[Dan Hurley]] |hc_year = 6th |asst_coach1=[[David Cox (basketball)|David Cox]] |asst_coach2=Tyron Boswell |asst_coach3=[[Tom Moore (basketball)|Tom Moore]] |asst_coach4= |stadium=[[Ryan Center]] |champion= Atlantic 10 regular season champions |bowl= [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |bowl_result = Second Round }} {{2017–18 Atlantic 10 men's basketball standings}} The '''2017–18 Rhode Island Rams basketball team''' represented the [[University of Rhode Island]] during the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Rams, led by sixth-year head coach [[Dan Hurley]], played their home games at the [[Ryan Center]] in [[Kingston, Rhode Island]] as members of the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]]. They finished the season 26–8, 15–3 in [[2017–18 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 play]] to finish win the A-10 regular season championship. They defeated [[2017–18 VCU Rams men's basketball team|VCU]] and [[2017–18 Saint Joseph's Hawks men's basketball team|Saint Joseph's]] to advance to the championship game of the [[2018 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]] where they lost to [[2017–18 Davidson Wildcats men's basketball team|Davidson]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated [[2017–18 Oklahoma Sooners men's basketball team|Oklahoma]] in the first round before losing in the second round to [[2017–18 Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team|Duke]]. On March 22, 2018, it was announced that head coach Dan Hurley had accepted the head coaching job at [[Connecticut Huskies men's basketball|Connecticut]].{{cite news|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/22862828/dan-hurley-leaves-rhode-island-become-uconn-men-basketball-coach|title=Dan Hurley leaving Rhode Island, named head coach at UConn|website=ESPN.com|first=Jeff|last=Goodman|date=March 22, 2018|access-date=March 22, 2018}}{{Cite news|url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/ncaab/aac/2018/03/22/dan-hurley-become-next-head-coach-uconn/448420002/|title=Dan Hurley to become next head coach at UConn|work=USA TODAY|access-date=2018-03-22|language=en}} On April 4, assistant coach [[David Cox (basketball)|David Cox]] was promoted to head coach.{{cite news|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/23028597/rhode-island-rams-promote-david-cox-replace-dan-hurley-coach|title=Assistant David Cox takes over as Rhode Island head coach|website=ESPN.com|first=Jeff|last=Goodman|date=April 4, 2018|access-date=April 4, 2018}} ==Previous season== The [[2016–17 Rhode Island Rams men's basketball team|Rams]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 25–10, 13–5 in [[2016–17 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 play]] to finish in a tie for third place. In the [[2017 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]], they defeated [[2016–17 St. Bonaventure Bonnies men's basketball team|St. Bonaventure]],{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=400946167|title=St. Bonaventure vs. Rhode Island – Game Recap – March 10, 2017 – ESPN|website=ESPN.com|access-date=2017-10-24}}
